items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Ravel came and visited and we were in the control room and he wanted to know what's that sound.

ctx.x: Yes, I think they became members of the band by then. The band went out and didn't do anything at one particular time, but as far as the recordings now, I want to get back to -- we went along with Victor for quite awhile and we made a bunch of records over at Leiderkrautz and then they -- let's see, at one of the rehearsals over there, Ravel came and visited and we were in the control room and he wanted to know what's that sound. It was Chester's subtone. He hadn't heard anything like that before. They wanted him…

He was no great reader, but he could read, as long as he had guys like Trumbauer and the other guys alongside of him, he knew where he was. Well, let's see, so there was something else I wanted to get said there.
